articles.title: Why bitcoin’s recent climb to $80,000 might just be a temporary liquidity squeeze
articles.snippet: Spot ETF outflows and a hawkish Federal Reserve are creating a "macro ceiling" that makes a new all-time high unlikely without a major geopolitical shift.

articles.title: BlackRock, Janus Henderson tokenized funds get instant redemptions with new $1 billion facility
articles.snippet: A new credit facility by Grove aims to allow instant redemptions into stablecoins from BlackRock's BUIDL and Janus Henderson's money market funds, reducing settlement time from days to instantaneous.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s recent $80,000 breakout was led by something other than U.S. spot buyers, data show
articles.snippet: The rally was led by leveraged traders and not U.S.-based spot buyers. Hence, its. sustainability is being questioned.

articles.title: Moody’s assigns Aaa-mf assessments to Fidelity International and BlackRock tokenized money market funds
articles.snippet: The assessment suggest the highest level of credit quality, liquidity and capital preservation.

articles.title: Only 4% of US voters consider crypto in candidate choice: Poll
articles.snippet: US adults are largely wary of crypto and consider it the least important policy issue when picking who to vote for, according to a poll by Politico.
